title: Water cannon as a weather service
situation: In the heat, students ask police to turn on the water cannon. Police spray; instead of scattering, students dance, sing and film reels in the water.
where: Patna, Bihar (Gandhi Maidan / JP Golambar area per Republic; Dak Bungalow crossing per IANS for the student protest)

lines.text: Police Sir, why is water cannon not being used on us, it's too hot here.
lines.speaker: protester (English rendering)

reactionBeats: Spray starts; students dance instead of running; bystanders encourage them (Navbharat).

quoted.text: Ye protest ho raha hai ya Holi ki party.
quoted.speaker: commenter

quoted.text: Tear gas experience k liye delhi aana padega dost.
quoted.speaker: commenter

quoted.text: Bro asked for tear Gas and water cannons.
quoted.speaker: commenter

quoted.text: My son is a GenZ..when ever rain comes he used to go to terrace and get drenched. Now I know why
